message: `mlpareto3` requires `min` (lower endpoint); it has no default. With min estimated the likelihood is unbounded: the density is singular at min when shape < 1, so let min rise to the sample minimum. Hold it, e.g. `mlpareto3(x, min = 0)`, which is `mlllogis(x)`. Fits with min free and other parameters held are not supported.
